title: Lexical Persistence Without Semantic Entrenchment in AI Agent Communities
abstract: arXiv:2610.20365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agent communities sustain lexical persistence, popular terms spread, recur, and achieve broad adoption, but whether they also develop the temporal semantic structure characteristic of human linguistic communities remains open. We compare MoltBook (AI agent community, 8 weeks), PTT (Chinese human BBS, 19 years), and Reddit (English human forum, in matched 8-week windows) using Compass-Aligned Distributional Embeddings (CADE), measuring semantic drift (B1), neighborhood stability (B2), and lag-1 autocorrelation of per-word drift trajectories. Across the platforms, lag-1 autocorrelation forms a memory-horizon continuum. AI agents' result clusters at the low end, while human platforms show longer-range temporal dependence. MoltBook exhibits approximately 2$\times$ the B1 drift and 20-30% lower B2 stability than both human platforms. As a partial control for community age, r/vibecoding (founded 2025-02-08) shows significant ACF in its firs

translated_title: AI智能体社区中缺乏语义固化的词汇持续性
translated_abstract: AI智能体社区能够维持词汇持续性——流行词汇会传播、复现并获得广泛采用——但它们是否也能发展出人类语言社区所特有的时间语义结构，这一问题仍悬而未决。我们使用罗盘对齐分布嵌入方法比较了三个平台：MoltBook（AI智能体社区，8周）、PTT（中文人类BBS论坛，19年）和Reddit（英文人类论坛，匹配的8周窗口），并测量了语义漂移（B1）、邻域稳定性（B2）以及逐词漂移轨迹的滞后一阶自相关性。研究发现，各平台的滞后一阶自相关性形成了一个“记忆视野”连续体：AI智能体的结果聚集在低端，而人类平台则表现出更长程的时间依赖性。MoltBook的B1语义漂移约为两个人类平台的2倍，B2稳定性则比两个人类平台低20-30%。作为对社区年龄的部分控制，创建于2025年2月8日的r/vibecoding子版块在其最初的…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过跨平台对比发现，AI智能体社区虽然能够维持词汇的流行与传播，但缺乏人类语言社区所具有的长程时间语义依赖结构，其语义漂移速度更快、语义稳定性更低。
en_tdlr: AI agent communities sustain lexical persistence but lack the long-range temporal semantic dependence characteristic of human linguistic communities, exhibiting roughly 2x faster semantic drift and 20-30% lower neighborhood stability.
